stops.name: Burg Egloffstein
stops.quote: Burg Egloffstein The symbol of Franconian Switzerland towers high above the Trubachtal valley.
stops.english: Egloffstein Castle, the symbol of Franconian Switzerland, towers high above the Trubachtal valley.

stops.name: Trubachtal valley
stops.quote: Burg Egloffstein The symbol of Franconian Switzerland towers high above the Trubachtal valley.
stops.english: Egloffstein Castle, the symbol of Franconian Switzerland, towers high above the Trubachtal valley.

stops.name: Markt Thurnau
stops.quote: The market town of Thurnau is home of numerous potters, artists and craftsmen.
stops.english: The market town of Thurnau is home to numerous potters, artists and craftsmen.

stops.name: Thurnau Pottery Museum
stops.quote: The Thurnau Pottery Museum and the Christmas market in the castle are particularly worth seeing.
stops.english: The Thurnau Pottery Museum and the Christmas market in the castle are particularly worth seeing.

stops.name: Limmersdorf
stops.quote: In the Franconian town of Limmersdorf, they celebrate the founding of the Lindenkirche at the end of August each year, around St. Bartholomew’s Day.
stops.english: In the Franconian town of Limmersdorf, they celebrate the founding of the Lindenkirche at the end of August each year, around St. Bartholomew’s Day.

stops.name: Sankt Johannes der Täufer
stops.quote: The Limmersdorfer Lindenkirchweih dates back to the year 1540 and the consecration of the church known as “Sankt Johannes der Täufer” (St. John the Baptist).
stops.english: The Limmersdorfer Lindenkirchweih dates back to the year 1540 and the consecration of the church known as “St. John the Baptist”.

stops.name: Tanzlinden-Radrundweg
stops.quote: The 31-kilometre circular cycle route connects the three Tanzlinden lime trees in Peesten, Limmersdorf and Langenstadt.
stops.english: The 31-kilometer circular cycle route connects the three Tanzlinden lime trees in Peesten, Limmersdorf, and Langenstadt.
